youtube_title: Friend Has Heatstroke: Force Ice Water or Cool Him in the Shade? Brave vs Normal #17 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BRAVE vs NORMAL, WHO'S RIGHT? #17. After cricket on a May afternoon, a friend collapses: burning hot, confused. Brave forces ice-cold water into his mouth. Normal moves him to the shade, calls 108, loosens his clothes, wet cloth and air. Comment B or N.
Answer: NORMAL. Heatstroke is a medical emergency. Someone not fully alert can choke if you force water. Cool the body first: shade, wet cloth, fanning, cold packs on neck and armpits, and call an ambulance (108 / 112). Give small sips only if the person is awake and alert.
Sources: HealthLink BC 'Emergency First Aid for Heatstroke'; MedlinePlus 'Heat emergencies'. General awareness, not medical advice.
